item.title: California schools with low vaccination rates lose millions of dollars
item.description: California schools lost more than $2.2 million in state funding over two years because some students did not have all the vaccinations required by state law, according to data obtained by EdSource from the California State Controller’s Office.

item.title: BPD asks for help ID'ing barber shop burglar
item.description: The Bakersfield Police Department is requesting the public’s help in identifying a man who it says broke into Ricardo’s Barber Shop and Salon in the 3200 block of Stine Road and stole items on Jan. 22.

item.title: BPD asks for help identifying 2 men it accused of a commercial burglary
item.description: The Bakersfield Police Department is requesting the public's assistance in identifying two men who it says stole merchandise Jan. 22 after breaking into the Last Chance Store in the 5300 block of White Lane.

item.title: BCSD trustees blasted for giving selves large raise while offering classified workers 1% increase
item.description: Speakers at a trustees meeting Tuesday took Bakersfield City School District board members to task for approving a raise for themselves that was far larger than the one being offered to classified staff.

item.title: CRC earns top certification for methane reductions
item.description: California’s largest oil producer announced Wednesday its efforts to control methane emissions at company operations in Kern and Fresno counties have garnered a top rating that supports its reputation and revenue as a low-carbon energy provider.

item.title: Celebrity priest Father Mike Schmitz draws thousands of faithful to Garces event Wednesday
item.description: Central California Catholics came by the thousands Wednesday to Garces Memorial High School in Bakersfield to see one of the most sought-after Catholic speakers in the United States.

item.title: City Council covers remote participation, trees and city spending
item.description: Bakersfield City Council meetings will have to incorporate remote participation options by July 1, thanks to changes made to the state’s public meetings law.

item.title: State really means everything to everybody in town for CIF championship tournament
item.description: If there’s one way to describe the CIF State Boys and Girls Wrestling Championships, the premier tournament in California that begins today and goes through Saturday evening’s individual title matches at Bakersfield’s Dignity Health Arena, is that it has everything.

item.title: Garces girls soccer seeks D-I CIF title; Condors lose game, but charity auction raises $18K; CSUB baseball falls in 12; BC recap
item.description: The Garces High girls soccer team will travel north to Clovis today to face No. 1-seeded Buchanan in the CIF Central Section Division 1 championship game in a 6 p.m. start.
